item.title: Woman tied to tree, stabbed and raped: Bayview police launch urgent manhunt
item.description: A woman was attacked, stabbed, and raped by two men near Woodhurst Park in Bayview, on Sunday afternoon.

item.title: Three arrested for brutal murder of Bolt driver in Pretoria, fourth suspect Still at large
item.description: Gauteng authorities have apprehended three suspects following the brutal murder of a 22-year-old Bolt driver who was lured by fake passengers in Pretoria West.

item.title: Durban Chamber reviews Ramaphosa's State of the Nation Address: optimism tempered by concerns
item.description: The Durban Chamber of Commerce and Industry says President Cyril Ramaphosa's SONA 2026 was positive but reactive. The Chamber wants clarity on AGOA, immediate action on illicit goods, and implementation focus.

item.title: Proteas’ remarkable turnaround: Learning from mistakes in T20 World Cup victory over New Zealand
item.description: South Africa's Kagiso Rabada (L) speaks with captain Aiden Markram during the 2026 ICC Men's T20 Cricket World Cup group stage match between New Zealand and South Africa at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad on February 14, 2026. Picture: Shammi MEHRA / AFP

item.title: IOL EXCLUSIVE: SAPS hunts Zimbabwe celebrity musician Malloti over armed robbery
item.description: Zimbabwean musician and social media personality Malloti is wanted in South Africa in connection with a 2017 Western Cape armed robbery case, SAPS has confirmed to IOL.

item.title: How multiple loan agreements impact home loan applications for South African consumers
item.description: The affordability assessment is a review of contractual debt repayments and monthly household expenses against the applicant’s net monthly income to ensure that the applicant has sufficient disposable income to cover the repayment of the monthly instalment on the home loan applied for without falling into financial distress.

item.title: Advertising watchdog rejects fears over ‘dangerous’ washing machine advert
item.description: A complaint that a TV advert could encourage children to climb into washing machines — with potentially fatal consequences — has been dismissed by the Advertising Regulatory Board

item.title: 34% of Western Cape Education staff undergo vetting
item.description: Andries Nel addresses stakeholders at Princeton High School in Mitchells Plain during an awareness event on compliance with the National Register for Sex Offenders.

item.title: Cosatu praises Ramaphosa’s 2026 Sona but demands a budget that supports workers
item.description: President Cyril Ramaphosa delivered one of his most critical State of the Nation Addresses (Sona) since assuming office in 2018, says the author.

item.title: Mother wins fight: health department ordered to pay lump-sum for cerebral palsy claim
item.description: IN A SIGNIFICANT legal victory, the Supreme Court of Appeal has ruled in favour of a mother who fought to receive lump-sum damages for her child born with cerebral palsy due to hospital negligence.
